items.before: Every caller of stackContainers or stackContainerIds now goes through psStackWithDocker: lease status, gate held-port checks, writeStackLogs, recordLeaseContainers. On macOS that runs `open -a Docker` and polls for up to TIM_DOCKER_START_WAIT_MS (default 5 minutes) whenever the daemon is unreachable. On a machine whose docker context is Colima or OrbStack, the daemon-unreachable stderr matches but `open -a Docker` fails. The user then sees 'Docker Desktop would not open' instead of the real cause.
items.after:

- recordLeaseContainers

Some machines have a docker context of Colima or OrbStack. There, the daemon-unreachable stderr matches, but `open -a Docker` fails.

The user then sees 'Docker Desktop would not open' instead of the real cause.

items.before: The retry runs for every method, including POST /notifications (create), /{id}/copy, /{id}/submit, /amend, /soft-delete, /notifications/{id}/document-uploads and /document-uploads/{id}/file. It fires if any cause in the chain has UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT, ECONNREFUSED or ETIMEDOUT. The first two can only happen before any request bytes are sent, including during the TLS handshake for an https target, so retrying on them is safe. ETIMEDOUT can also be raised on an established keep-alive socket, from a kernel keepalive or retransmission failure after the request has been written. The logs only show ETIMEDOUT nested under UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT (AggregateError from internalConnectMultiple), so it adds no coverage.
